html:
Nha Trang, one of Vietnam’s most famous coastal cities, has long been a dream destination for travelers thanks to its stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters. Among countless exciting activities, the Nha Trang Four Islands Tour is considered an essential experience, offering visitors a complete exploration of the bay’s natural beauty and vibrant marine life.

So, what makes the Four Islands Tour so special? How much does it cost, and when is the best time to go? Let’s dive into this comprehensive guide to help you plan the perfect island-hopping adventure in 2026.

Discovering The Nha Trang Four Islands Tour – A Fascinating Sea Journey

Nha Trang Bay is proudly recognized as one of the world’s most beautiful bays, featuring 19 islands of various sizes, with 14 islands developed for tourism. The Four Islands Tour is carefully designed to showcase the most outstanding highlights of the bay, combining pristine nature with exciting sea activities.

A typical itinerary includes visits to Hon Mun Island, Bai Tranh Beach, Tri Nguyen Aquarium, and a local Fishing Village. Each destination has its own unique charm—from vibrant coral reefs and white sandy beaches to traditional floating villages and fresh seafood experiences.

This tour is not just about sightseeing; it is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the rhythm of coastal life, explore local culture, and create unforgettable memories. With its ideal location and natural advantages, Nha Trang has become one of Vietnam’s leading marine tourism hubs, offering everything from snorkeling and water sports to luxury resorts and island retreats.

The Best Time To Experience The Nha Trang Four Islands Tour

Nha Trang enjoys a mild climate year-round, making it possible to visit at almost any time. However, choosing the right season will significantly enhance your island tour experience.

According to travel experts and locals, February to September is the best time to join the Four Islands Tour. During this period, the weather is dry, sunny, and calm, perfect for swimming, snorkeling, and outdoor activities.

The summer months (June to August) are especially lively, with vibrant beach atmospheres and seasonal events, making it an ideal choice for families and summer holiday travelers.

From October to December, Nha Trang may experience occasional rain and rougher seas. While not constant, sudden showers or waves may affect island activities. If traveling during this period, it is recommended to monitor weather forecasts and choose flexible tour options.

Highlights Of The Four Islands Tour In Nha Trang

Hon Mun Island – A Paradise For Snorkeling And Diving

Hon Mun Island is named after its black rock formations resembling ebony wood. Despite its small size, Hon Mun is the first marine protected area in Vietnam and home to more than 350 coral species, accounting for nearly half of the world’s known coral species.

Visitors can enjoy snorkeling or scuba diving to explore a colorful underwater world filled with coral reefs, tropical fish, and unique marine creatures. The island also offers peaceful spots to relax, swim, and enjoy the refreshing sea breeze. For photography lovers, bringing a waterproof camera is highly recommended.

Bai Tranh Beach – Endless Fun And Water Activities

Bai Tranh Beach is a popular stop on the Four Islands Tour, known for its long white sandy shore and clear turquoise waters. The beach offers a perfect balance between relaxation and adventure.

Here, visitors can sunbathe, swim, or participate in exciting water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat rides, and snorkeling. Small beachside restaurants also serve refreshments and light meals, making it easy to recharge after a fun-filled morning.

Fishing Village – Local Life And Fresh Seafood

The Fishing Village offers a glimpse into the daily life of local fishermen. Visitors can observe floating fish farms and learn about traditional aquaculture practices.

The highlight of this stop is the seafood experience. Guests can select freshly caught seafood such as grouper, lobster, squid, or shrimp, which is then prepared on the spot. The fresh, authentic flavors of the sea make this an unforgettable culinary experience. Visitors can also purchase dried seafood and local specialties as souvenirs.

Tri Nguyen Aquarium – A Unique Marine Museum On The Sea

Tri Nguyen Aquarium, also known as Tri Nguyen Marine Park, features a distinctive structure shaped like an ancient pirate ship. Inside, visitors can explore a variety of marine species through interconnected tanks and glass tunnels.

The aquarium showcases thousands of sea creatures, from colorful reef fish to rare marine species. This destination is especially suitable for families with children, offering both educational and entertaining experiences. Nearby cafés and souvenir shops provide convenient spots to relax.

Nha Trang Four Islands Tour Prices 2026 And Cost Factors

Tour prices vary depending on several factors, including tour type, transportation, included services, and travel season.

Group Tours

  • Wooden boat tours: approximately 250,000 – 400,000 VND per person

  • Speedboat tours: approximately 450,000 – 650,000 VND per person

These prices usually include transportation, lunch, entrance fees to selected islands, and basic travel insurance. Optional activities such as diving or water sports may incur additional charges.

Private Tours

Private tours are ideal for families or groups seeking flexibility and privacy. Prices depend on group size and service level but offer customized itineraries, extended island stops, and premium services.

Seasonal Factors

Prices may increase slightly during peak seasons such as summer holidays and public festivals. Off-season travel may offer better deals and promotions.

Essential Items To Bring For Your Four Islands Tour

  • Sunscreen, hat, sunglasses

  • Swimwear and lightweight clothing

  • Waterproof sandals or flip-flops

  • Phone, camera, power bank

  • Waterproof bags for electronics

  • Personal medication and seasickness pills

  • Cash and identification documents

  • Snorkeling gear (optional but recommended)

Should You Join A Tour Or Travel Independently?

Advantages Of Joining A Tour

  • Cost-effective and time-saving

  • Well-organized itinerary

  • Professional guides and safety assurance

  • Access to discounted activity prices

  • Ideal for first-time visitors

Advantages Of Independent Travel

  • Flexible schedule

  • Personalized exploration

  • Deeper local interaction

  • Suitable for small, experienced travel groups

Overall, guided tours are highly recommended for convenience, safety, and value, especially for first-time visitors to Nha Trang.

Final Tips For A Perfect Island Adventure

  • Book tours early during peak seasons

  • Choose reputable tour operators

  • Protect the marine environment

  • Try local specialties such as fish noodle soup and grilled fermented pork

  • Prepare backup plans for weather changes
